remarks: Welcome to 43 Old Highway! This 4-bedroom, 2.5 bath Cape has a versatile floor plan that can serve many different lifestyles. Upon entering the home, you will find a two-story foyer that opens to the living room with built-in bookshelves and dining room, perfect for gathering for a dinner party or holiday with family and friends. The large eat in kitchen is sure to impress with a center island, granite counters and stainless-steel appliances. The large, adjoining family room has a fireplace and French doors to the outdoor deck. The primary bedroom is located on the first floor with a vaulted ceiling, full bath and plenty of closet space including a walk-in closet. A home office, half bath, laundry and mudroom complete the first floor. Upstairs you will find 3 additional bedrooms and a newly renovated full bath (2024). Other features of the home include a rec/playroom located just steps away from kitchen, recessed lighting, hardwood floors and two car garage. This home provides privacy yet it's close to town, train and major highways. Book your appointment today!
